name: recon_tool_enabled_agent
description: Customer-support agent with read/write tools, email-send, and an approval gate for refund / account-status changes. user-delegated identity, medium scope.

expected.note: Tools + external APIs amplify the hijack surface.
Send-email, update-record, create-ticket are write actions; only refund gated.
user-delegated identity + medium scope; approval gate softens this.
Depends on external APIs whose contracts can change.
No memory loop; no chained-decision surface.
Sends customer-facing emails and updates records.
